metadata.scenario: A caller asks for directions to the nearest branch location. Category: General Information.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret, how can I help you today? Hi, Margaret. My name is Michael Brown. I found your number through the hospital discharge planning department. Nice to meet you, Michael! How can I assist you? Well, my father has diabetes and he needs wound care and medication management. We can definitely help with that. We offer skilled nursing care for wound care and medication management. That sounds good. But first, I need directions to your nearest branch location. Of course! We're located at 2847 North Ridge Road, Suite 205, Wichita, KS 67205. Great, can you tell me how to get there? Sure! If you’re coming from the downtown area, take Central Avenue north until you reach Ridge Road. Okay, Central Avenue north to Ridge Road. What next? Then turn right on Ridge Road, and we’re on the left side, just past the intersection with 29th Street. Got it, thank you! What are your business hours? We're open Monday to Friday from 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM, and Saturday from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Perfect! And do you have someone who can handle diabetes management? Yes, we have skilled nurses who specialize in diabetes management as well. That's reassuring. How soon can we schedule an appointment? I can connect you with our care coordinator, Lisa Chen, to set up an initial assessment. That would be great! What’s Lisa’s contact number? You can reach her directly at +13165559203. She can assist with scheduling and care plans. Thanks! I’ll call her after this. Do you accept insurance for these services? Yes, we do accept various insurance plans. Lisa can help with insurance authorization as well. Awesome. One last thing, can I get an estimate for the wound care service? Our wound care management is priced between $75 to $95 for a 30-45 minute visit. That sounds reasonable. Thank you so much for your help! You're welcome, Michael! Let us know if you have any other questions. I appreciate it. Have a great day! You too! Goodbye!
